title: 21 Savage Appears to Show First Look at Newborn Baby With Latto
summary: The Atlanta rapper was celebrating Arsenal's Premier League victory.
contentText:
21 Savage and Latto appeared to welcome their first child together in recent weeks, and the Atlanta rapper seemingly gave fans a first look at their bundle of joy.

Related

A Timeline of Latto & 21 Savage’s Relationship

Latto Appears to Confirm She’s Given Birth to Her First Child: Watch the Video Featuring 21 Savage

Latto Says ‘Big Mama’ Album Will Be Her Last: ‘My Retirement Album’

21 was celebrating Arsenal’s Premier League victory earlier this week and made sure his little one was in the right threads, as he laced the newborn with an Arsenal onesie. However, the baby’s face and head aren’t pictured.

“We Did It !!!!!!!!! @arsenal,” the Slaughter Gang rapper captioned May 20 the carousel of photos on Instagram cheering on Arsenal.

Arsenal took home the Premier League crown on Tuesday (May 19) for the first time in 22 years after Manchester City didn’t beat Bournemouth.

Latto and 21’s relationship has been one of hip-hop’s worst kept secrets, as speculation surrounding them being a couple continued to mount in recent years. Latto seemingly confirmed her relationship with 21 when posting a video following her pregnancy journey, which featured an appearance from the “A Lot” rapper.

The video gave fans a behind-the-scenes look into Latto’s pregnancy , starting at five weeks and closing with a teaser of her in the delivery room giving birth. 21 made a cameo at the baby shower, which also saw Usher, Sexyy Red and WNBA star Angel Reese stop by.

“I’m so ready to meet my baby,” Latto said in the video. “I’m never gonna leave when my baby get here. I need $1 million a show because I don’t want to leave the house.” The baby’s gender or name wasn’t revealed in the footage.

Latto’s gearing up to drop her Big Mama album on May 29, which she claims will be her final LP. “5/29 My retirement album Thank you for everything,” the 28-year-old wrote  on X  May 8 after  revealing her pregnancy  in March.

Before Big Mama , Latto’s most recent album came in 2024; Sugar Honey Iced Tea peaked at No. 15 on the  Billboard 200 .
